aliases: Fab underutilization with high fixed costs

risk_factors.name: Semiconductor materials and wafer supply shortages
risk_factors.definition: Limited or constrained supply of silicon wafers, key materials, chemicals, and equipment from few suppliers or geographies could prevent adequate production.
aliases: Limited-source equipment and materials supply shortage

risk_factors.name: Emissions non-compliance penalties and recalls
risk_factors.definition: Alleged violations of fuel economy and emissions rules could result in fines, recalls, restricted offerings or facility idling.
aliases: Fuel economy and emissions non-compliance penalties

risk_factors.name: Intellectual property misappropriation and weak enforcement
aliases: Intellectual property misappropriation and weak enforcement

risk_factors.name: IP infringement and misappropriation claims
risk_factors.definition: Third-party infringement claims, including from non-practicing entities, and theft or misappropriation of the company's IP could cause damages, injunctions, or loss of competitive advantage.
aliases: Trade secret theft and patent infringement claims

risk_factors.name: Joint venture compliance and misconduct exposure
risk_factors.definition: Limited control over joint ventures may result in partners failing to follow the company's governance, reporting or compliance standards, leading to fines and reputational harm.
aliases: Joint venture compliance and misconduct exposure

risk_factors.name: Joint venture funding and execution shortfalls
risk_factors.definition: Alliances and joint ventures may impose funding or take-or-pay obligations and may fail to meet production timing or quality targets.
aliases: Joint venture funding and execution shortfall

risk_factors.name: Joint venture partner and control risk
aliases: Joint venture partner and control risk

risk_factors.name: Skilled engineering talent attraction and retention
risk_factors.definition: The risk that competition for skilled engineers and technical staff prevents the company from attracting and retaining the talent needed to develop its products and operate its business.
aliases: Shortage of skilled software engineering talent

risk_factors.name: Labor union and works council disruption
aliases: Labor union and works council disruption

risk_factors.name: Customer loss from trade measures
risk_factors.definition: Large customers may curtail purchases due to sourcing policy changes, tariffs, export controls or other trade measures.
aliases: Large customer purchase curtailment from trade measures

risk_factors.name: Low-cost foreign OEM competition
risk_factors.definition: Lower-cost Chinese and Indian vehicle manufacturers compete in emerging and established markets, eroding pricing and market share.

risk_factors.name: Macroeconomic demand volatility in automotive end markets
aliases: Macroeconomic demand volatility in automotive end markets

risk_factors.name: New vehicle launch and acceptance risk
aliases: New vehicle launch and acceptance risk

risk_factors.name: North American raw materials supply shortfall
aliases: North American raw materials supply shortfall

risk_factors.name: Pandemic disruption to workforce and suppliers
aliases: Pandemic disruption to workforce and suppliers

risk_factors.name: Patent infringement litigation and injunction exposure
aliases: Patent infringement litigation and injunction exposure

risk_factors.name: Semiconductor defect liability and recall costs
risk_factors.definition: Defects in semiconductor components can lead to product liability claims and charge-backs of customers' recall and replacement costs that may exceed product value and insurance coverage.
aliases: Product liability and customer recall costs

risk_factors.name: Product security vulnerabilities harming demand
risk_factors.definition: Security vulnerabilities in the company's products used in critical applications could reduce customer demand and create liability.

risk_factors.name: Profit concentration in full-size trucks
risk_factors.definition: Dependence on high-margin full-size ICE trucks and SUVs exposes profits to oil price spikes and fuel economy rules.
aliases: Profit concentration in full-size ICE trucks

risk_factors.name: Refinancing risk and insufficient debt service cash
aliases: Refinancing risk and insufficient debt service cash

risk_factors.name: Restructuring and strategic change execution
risk_factors.definition: The risk that restructuring or strategic change initiatives incur unexpected costs, disrupt operations or customers, or fail to deliver intended benefits.

risk_factors.name: Industry overcapacity causing price erosion
risk_factors.definition: Industry capacity additions create overcapacity that erodes prices and margins and leaves manufacturing capacity under-utilized.

risk_factors.name: Semiconductor average selling price erosion
risk_factors.definition: Declining prices for semiconductor products, especially older ones, pressure margins and require cost reductions.
aliases: Semiconductor price erosion on older products

risk_factors.name: US-China semiconductor tariffs and trade restrictions
risk_factors.definition: Tariffs, trade investigations, and trade restrictions arising from US-China tensions raise costs, reduce demand, or restrict the company's semiconductor sales and supply chains.

risk_factors.name: Slow EV adoption after incentive termination
aliases: Slow EV adoption after incentive termination

risk_factors.name: State-backed Chinese semiconductor competition
risk_factors.definition: Chinese government policy and investment supporting domestic semiconductor makers, along with other emerging Asian competitors, pressure pricing and margins.

risk_factors.name: Stock price volatility and securities litigation
aliases: Stock price volatility and securities litigation

risk_factors.name: Substantial indebtedness and debt service burden
aliases: Substantial indebtedness and debt service burden

risk_factors.name: Limited recovery of supplier defect costs
risk_factors.definition: Component defects discovered long after production may result in costs the company cannot recover from suppliers due to their limited financial condition or other constraints.

risk_factors.name: Supplier disruption under just-in-time production
risk_factors.definition: Because the company operates with minimal inventory and single-source parts, disruptions at suppliers can quickly halt production, including of higher-margin vehicles.

risk_factors.name: Combined tariffs and export controls disruption
risk_factors.definition: New or increased US and China tariffs, export controls and sanctions could disrupt trade and harm sales and operations.
aliases: Tariffs and export controls disrupting trade

risk_factors.name: Tax law changes and IRA incentive realization
aliases: Tax law changes and IRA incentive realization

risk_factors.name: Technological change shortening product life cycles
aliases: Technological change shortening product life cycles

risk_factors.name: Technological obsolescence and price erosion
risk_factors.definition: Rapid technological change and larger competitors may render products obsolete and erode prices while R&D costs rise.
aliases: Technological obsolescence and competitive price erosion

risk_factors.name: Disruption from new automotive competitors
risk_factors.definition: Start-ups and technology entrants in EVs, AVs, software and ridesharing may disrupt the company's core business.
aliases: Technology disruption from new automotive competitors

risk_factors.name: Transfer pricing disputes and tax asset challenges
aliases: Transfer pricing disputes and tax asset challenges

risk_factors.name: Uncertain IP ownership of AI technologies
risk_factors.definition: Unsettled law on ownership of AI-generated or AI-assisted intellectual property may limit the company's ability to protect its innovations.
aliases: Uncertain IP ownership of AI technologies

risk_factors.name: US-China tensions restricting repatriation and technology
risk_factors.definition: Risk that U.S.-China tensions lead to restrictions on repatriating dividends from China or on technology exports, harming the company's operations and returns.

risk_factors.name: Vehicle safety recall costs
risk_factors.definition: Safety defects in vehicles, including autonomous vehicles, can trigger costly recalls across global platforms, regulatory investigations, and reputational damage.

risk_factors.name: Working capital volatility from long cycles
risk_factors.definition: Long development-to-delivery periods require high inventory and work-in-progress, creating volatile working capital needs.
aliases: Working capital volatility from long product cycles
